about: H3 round 2 (layered rigs + replacement heads/hands). 'cannot_attempt': test poses with no output in out/; their forced renders are in gaps/forced/ as evidence only. 'partial': what the attempted poses cannot show. 'library_gaps': head/hand drawings the critics asked for that exist in no painting outside the target's family. Each gap names the painting that would close it.

masters.front: poet.11.main-poses/02-front-guide-stone (family poet.11, not a target family)
masters.q3r: poet.10.main-poses/q1-approach-bike (family poet.10, not a target family): 3/4 to screen right, walking; the bike is cut away, the forward boot's toe is cut flat where the tyre crossed it
masters.profile: none. The only whole profile painting outside the target families is poet.11/03-walk-profile-colonnade (mid-stride, far limbs hidden). No target needs a true profile once the 3/4 rig exists: falter and phone-palm are 3/4.
masters.rear 3/4 (poet.11/01-wall-rear-three-qua: examined and rejected as a 3/4 master: it is a back view (the face is a profile seen from behind).

poet.04.main-poses/04-2-heart-seated.why: One shin lies on the ground pointing into depth and the other knee comes toward the viewer; neither master has a bent leg seen that way, and squashing a straight shin in the picture plane crosses the legs into a tangle (gaps/forced). No kneeling painting exists outside poet.04 except 13/04 (with flowers).
poet.04.main-poses/04-2-heart-seated.painting_brief: 3/4-right kneel on one knee, red/black suit, no props, both hands empty at the sides, sunglasses on; as layers: pelvis + both legs separately.

poet.05.main-poses/q3-restless-lying-2.why: No master lies down. Turning the front rig 44 deg gives an upright front figure laid on its side: face, propping arm and foreshortened legs are wrong (gaps/forced). Both lying paintings are poet.05 (the target's family).
poet.05.main-poses/q3-restless-lying-2.painting_brief: The poet lying on his side, head to screen-left, propped on one hand, seen from the front; legs straight; parts as layers.

poet.13.main-poses/part-2.why: The painting is a crop (left half of the figure cut away) and its Pose Lab markers are misplaced (neck on the cup hand). Posed by hand on the 3/4 rig, the seat fails: with the thighs at 90 deg the walking master's waist (inpainted under the jacket) opens into a red-and-black smear, and there is no cup anywhere outside poet.13 (gaps/forced).
poet.13.main-poses/part-2.painting_brief: 3/4-right seated figure on an invisible seat, thighs horizontal toward screen-right, shins vertical, one hand on the knee, one raised to the mouth (holding a small cup as a separate prop).

partial.poet.13.main-poses/06-refocus: Sunglasses: in the painting they are off and held in his left hand. Every head outside poet.13 wears them (no glasses-off head exists outside 13/06 and 13/07, the target's family), so the face keeps them and the left hand is a closed fist (from 08/03) at the waist instead of holding glasses. The raised right hand is an open palm beside the head, not fingertips at the temple.
partial.poet.12.main-poses/02: Laughing head: the only laughing heads are poet.12 (the target's family); the head used is 11/welcome-new-day (looking up, mouth slightly open). poet.12's own style (thick tan outline, larger head) is not reproduced.
partial.poet.07.main-poses/push-two-sides-apart: The stop palms (from 08/07) face the viewer; in the painting they are seen nearly edge-on. Head is the 3/4-right head of 10/q1.
partial.poet.04.main-poses/04-6-rise-flex-reflec: poet.04's chest disc is not in the masters. Raised open hands are from 11/welcome-new-day; the painting's hands are more cupped.
partial.poet.04.main-poses/04-4-empty-cuffs: The empty cuffs are drawn as an ellipse (dark opening, tan rim) on the master's sleeve end; poet.04's own empty-cuff drawings are the target's family. The crouch spreads the knees sideways (thighs cannot point at the viewer). Chest disc absent.
partial.poet.08.main-poses/03-gentle-slow-bent-k: Rendered on the front rig (the 3/4 rig's walking legs tangled); the body is frontal where the painting is a slight 3/4. Head 06/set-down (looking down); fists from 12/02.
partial.poet.08.main-poses/05-chest-lean-opened-: Head thrown back is 11/05-read-water-reathe-1's head; the chest arch is only a lean in the picture plane.
partial.poet.09.main-poses/falter-at-shoulder-co: 3/4 rig. The reaching arm is the far arm: its shoulder is hidden behind the chest, so the sleeve appears to start under the collar. Reaching hand from 08/07.
partial.poet.09.main-poses/phone-palm: 3/4 rig, cropped like the painting. No phone: the only phones are poet.09 (the target's family); the hand at the ear is the master's own open hand turned up. Legs keep some of the walking stance.

library_gaps.head turned away / back of head (suit): none outside poet.14.exit (a rear sheet, not a whole painting); not needed by the test set
library_gaps.true profile head: 11/03-walk-profile-colonnade has one; not needed by the test set
library_gaps.empty cuff (round opening): poet.04 only (04-4, 04-5); drawn here as an ellipse instead
library_gaps.pointing: 07/o06-point-at (poet.07), usable for any target but 07/push; not needed by the test set
library_gaps.clench (half-closed hand) for the move's: none painted; the move uses a one-frame forearm cock with the open hand instead
